# SeEx v1.1.3

## 中文

本补丁版本修复了手动导入界面布局问题和剪贴板监听可靠性问题。

### 修复

- 修复手动导入输入框在输入大量 ID 时会被垂直拉伸的布局问题。
  - 输入框现在使用固定高度（92px）的可滚动区域
  - 输入大量 ID 时界面保持一致，不会变形
  
- 修复剪贴板监听在某些情况下可能卡住或无法捕获 ID 的问题。
  - 改进初始化逻辑，应用启动时如果剪贴板已有有效 ID 会立即处理
  - 增加连续错误计数和指数退避机制，提高容错性
  - 只有在连续 5 次以上错误后才重置剪贴板句柄，避免因临时访问问题导致监听中断
  - 更好地处理其他应用程序临时占用剪贴板的情况

### 技术改进

- 增强 `MonitorState::process_clipboard_change()` 的初始化逻辑
- 改进剪贴板轮询线程的错误处理机制
- 为手动导入文本框添加 ScrollArea 约束

## 贡献者

- @ref42

## English

This patch release fixes the manual import layout issue and improves clipboard monitoring reliability.

### Fixed

- Fixed manual import input box stretching vertically when entering many IDs.
  - Input box now uses a fixed-height scrollable area (92px)
  - Interface remains consistent when entering large numbers of IDs
  
- Fixed clipboard monitoring getting stuck or failing to capture IDs in certain scenarios.
  - Improved initialization to process valid IDs already in clipboard at app startup
  - Added consecutive error counting and exponential backoff for better resilience
  - Only resets clipboard handle after 5+ consecutive errors, avoiding interruptions from temporary access issues
  - Better handling when other applications temporarily block clipboard access

### Technical Improvements

- Enhanced `MonitorState::process_clipboard_change()` initialization logic
- Improved clipboard polling thread error handling mechanism
- Added ScrollArea constraint to manual import TextEdit widget
